newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ITC Ltd 96/97 net rises.
newsitem.headline: India's ITC Ltd 96/97 net rises.

text.p: India's ITC Ltd on Saturday said that it posted a net profit of 3.47 billion rupees in 1996/97 (April-March) compared with 2.61 billion rupees in the previous year.
The company recorded a gross income of 59.60 billion rupees in 1996/97, up 15 percent over the previous year, the hotel and tobacco conglomerate said in a statement.
The company's profit before tax for 1996/97 stood at 5.87 billion rupees, an increase of 30 percent over 1995/96 figures.
"Foreign exchange earnings amounting to 6.53 billion are marginally higher than last year," the company said.
